src: 3x3 glyphs left of a vertical divider, plus a gray start marker on the right
dst: a single polyline in the left canvas starting at the shifted gray marker
match_cond: glyphs ordered by tile column (left→right), then tile row (top→bottom)
transform: remove divider, shift gray into the left canvas, then append one segment per glyph while moving downward; segment length+orientation are determined by glyph type (area 4→vertical len2; area 5→horizontal len3 right; area 6→horizontal len4 left; area 7→horizontal len2 left)
